研究站与改良弹 / Research Outpost

研究站花资金积累全队数据，每辆战车可以单独购买一次改良弹药
The outpost earns team-wide research data and each rover can buy a single ammunition upgrade

使用方式 / Getting started
1 导入 .rwmod，启用后重新加载 / Import the .rwmod, enable it and reload
2 在沙盒搜索 rwa04 或单位英文名称 / Search the sandbox for rwa04 or the English unit name
3 按下方步骤逐项观察 / Follow the checks below

1 在沙盒放置研究站和两辆研究战车
   Place an outpost and two research rovers in the sandbox
2 研究两次，确认界面显示两份全队数据
   Run research twice and confirm the shared total reaches two
3 只升级其中一辆，比较两辆的弹体颜色与伤害
   Upgrade one rover and compare projectile color and damage
4 尝试再次升级同一辆，确认按钮提示已经完成
   Try upgrading the same rover again and verify the lock message

验证说明 / Verification
字段与引用按 Rusted Warfare 1.15 参考目录检查，尚未在游戏引擎中运行
Fields and references are checked against the Rusted Warfare 1.15 reference catalog, in-game behavior has not been tested

素材与许可 / Assets and license
本项目代码、文档与小尺寸像素图片为原创教学内容，以 CC0-1.0 提供
Original tutorial code, documentation and small pixel sprites are provided under CC0-1.0

地图片段 / Map fragments
若包含 XML，它只作为现有有效地图的对象片段使用，不是独立 TMX 地图
Any included XML is a fragment for an existing valid map, not a standalone TMX map
